caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, vertically-oriented section of a carpet or tapestry with an ornate design. The primary background color is a muted beige or tan, with an elaborate pattern consisting of swirls, floral motifs, and geometric shapes in shades of light gray, cream, red, and brown. Central to the composition is a large oval medallion with a pink or coral background; within this oval, there is a white, symmetrical motif resembling floral or feathered forms. The medallion is outlined by thin gold and gray borders. Scattered across the beige field surrounding the central oval are abstract floral shapes in red, brown, and beige, along with some small, circular reddish accents. The entire design is set against a plain, off-white or cream background, emphasizing the central carpet segment.
title: Brussels Carpet
